# M1 Car Lift

## What This Business Does

M1 Car Lift is a licensed car lift and private transport service operating between Sharjah and Dubai in the United Arab Emirates. The business provides daily shared transport for commuters who live in Sharjah and work in Dubai, as well as one-time bookings and corporate transport packages.

## Service Description

M1 Car Lift connects passengers from major Sharjah residential and commercial areas to Dubai's key employment districts. The service operates Monday through Saturday, 08:00 AM to 10:00 PM.

This is a car lift service (also called car pool or ride-sharing), where multiple passengers share a vehicle for the same general route, splitting the journey cost. It is distinct from a taxi or rideshare app: routes and schedules are structured in advance, and passengers book recurring or one-time slots.

## Frequently Asked Questions (Summary)

**What is a car lift service?** A car lift service is a structured shared transport arrangement where multiple passengers traveling the same route share a vehicle and split the cost. It is booked in advance, unlike a taxi hailed on demand.

**How much does a Sharjah–Dubai car lift cost?** Pricing varies by route and booking type. Contact M1 Car Lift for a quote. Most commuters save 30–50% versus daily taxis for the same route.

**Is car lift safe?** Yes. M1 Car Lift drivers are licensed, background-checked, and insured. Vehicles are maintained to roadworthy standards.

**How do I book?** Via the online form at https://www.m1carlift.com, or WhatsApp/call +971 56 582 8471.
